Almond Butter Cups
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Monday, July 16, 2012 - 11:21am

Ingredients




1 1/2 cups almond butter
12 chunks dark chocolate (Xocai Healthy Chocolate Nuggets)
12 cups pastry (store bought pastry cups

Preparation

1 Put 1-2 tsp. of almond butter in each cup; put Nugget on top and put in oven to warm until Nuggets melt. Makes 12 cups
